purpose: Test whether typed similarity witnesses remain non-vacuous when mappings can be flexible, and whether stronger probe families correctly refine equivalence rather than silently escalating it.
blocking_invariants: relation-specific admissible mapping family declared before candidate fitting
unit/type/causal-role constraints cannot be discarded to obtain a match
observational equivalence cannot mint interventional or mechanistic equivalence
a stronger nested probe family may split an equivalence class but cannot justify merging classes solely because more probes were added
candidate retrieval may use expressive models but certification requires an explicit admissible witness
failed distinguishing probes and rejected mappings remain negative history

worlds.falsifies_if: system promotes SAME_MECHANISM or CAUSALLY_EQUIVALENT without an intervention witness
system treats equivalence under the smaller probe family as global
adding probes alone merges previously distinct objects under unchanged tolerances/maps
a numerically convenient map is accepted despite incompatible dimensions
an unrestricted learned map is enough to certify deep equivalence
mapping score on a structure-shuffled null is accepted without a null-calibration penalty
many low-level interventions with divergent effects are silently collapsed to one high-level intervention
one-step agreement is promoted to trajectory-level equivalence
role labels match while intervention direction is reversed
the decisive counterexample disappears after a successor mapping is proposed

promotion_rule: No runtime map-certification, equivalence-refinement, or active similarity behavior may be promoted from Round 012 unless this frozen packet is executed first under the same candidate subject, with all blocking invariants clean. Thresholds, admissible map families, tolerances and probe families may not be widened after results are observed.
